audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 2, 4 and 5 read Ziggs / Ziggs / Skill here, while the already-audited mirror (ornn__ziggs) settled them as Skill / Ornn / Ornn and raised its own Level 6 row to 7/10.
audit.why: Level 3 is decided by geometry, not range — Volcanic Rupture creates its own magma pillar, so Ornn supplies the wall that Searing Charge slams you into and there is no 'stay off terrain' answer once he can build terrain. Level 6 and first item are his: Call of the Forge God crosses 2500 with a knockup and Brittle, and Living Forge hands him bonus resists plus free masterwork items.
audit.corrected: phases[2].side + win[2] to Skill (8/10 -> 5/10); phases[4].side + win[4] to Ornn (8/10 -> 3/10, the inverse of the mirror's 7/10); phases[5].side + win[5] to Ornn (5/10 -> 4/10). All as matched pairs in one atomic group, with the three contradicting why lines rewritten on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and phases[5].why described your Mega Inferno Bomb and Blackfire Torch spikes on rows that belong to Ornn, and no ult timer appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s — the longest cooldown in the lane and the one that decides whether you can step up at all. Living Forge is a permanent economic spike, not a level one, so 'first item' is not a Ziggs row against him.
audit.corrected: Both why lines restated; 140s and 2500 written into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text described Call of the Forge God as 'a long-range charge that knocks up' — that is not what it does. No cooldowns or ranges appeared anywhere on the page, and dosFull[2].d / dontsFull[0].d were filler.
audit.why: The ult summons an elemental at a location that travels toward him, damaging, slowing and applying Brittle to anyone it runs over; he then recasts to charge into it and redirect it, which is the knockup. Treating it as one charge makes you dodge the wrong thing. Volcanic Rupture is 800 range on 9s, Bellows Breath applies Brittle, Searing Charge is 450 and only knocks up on terrain collision.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten to the real two-part ult with its 140s timer; 9s and 800 into breakdown.cooldowns and phases[2].why; Living Forge's resist bonus into dontsFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Count it out loud if you must' with nothing to count.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s — the window you actually step into — and Searing Charge is 14s, so a whiffed Q genuinely opens the lane for the length of one poke rotation.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Ornn can't read the angle.
edits.after: Volcanic Rupture is 800 range and leaves a pillar — that pillar is the wall Searing Charge slams you into.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God crosses 2500, slows and applies Brittle — this row is his, so hold Satchel for the ram.

edits.before: Blackfire Torch spike — your Q chunks become unhealable burn chip. Ornn now chooses between farm and HP every wave.
edits.after: Living Forge gives him bonus resists and free masterwork items — one Blackfire Torch does not out-scale a forge.

edits.before: Lvl 3 you stay off walls and out-poke his only trade pattern.
edits.after: Lvl 3 comes down to walls: near terrain his combo wins.

edits.before: Lvl 6 his R is slow and dodgeable so you keep out-spacing him.
edits.after: Lvl 6 his R crosses 2500 and knocks up — that row is his.

edits.before: At first item Liandry's poke beats his forged tankiness in lane.
edits.after: At first item his free forged items out-value your single one.

edits.before: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — Pillar + knockup setup — stay off walls and sidestep the line. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Ornn Volcanic Rupture: matchup-defining — 800 range on a 9s cooldown, and its own pillar is the wall Searing Charge slams you into. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.

edits.before: Ornn whiffs Volcanic Rupture and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: A whiffed Volcanic Rupture buys you 9 seconds of open ground.

edits.before: That is Ornn’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Living Forge stacks extra resists on everything he buys.

edits.before: R Call of the Forge God gives him a long-range charge that knocks up and a brittle detonation, but it's slow and dodgeable — hold W Satchel Charge to jink the ram and keep chunking him, since his ult doesn't give him a way to reach your poke range safely.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God summons an elemental up to 2500 away that rolls toward him, slowing and applying Brittle to anyone it runs over; he recasts to charge into it and knock you up. It's 140s at rank 1 — dodge the roll first, then the ram.

notes: Chart rows 2, 4 and 5 proposed as matched pairs in one atomic group, following the mirror. Level 6 set to 3/10 as the inverse of the mirror's 7/10. Carried over the mirror's open item and did NOT write it: nothing in either kit file confirms that Ornn's magma pillar body-blocks Bouncing Bomb, so no line here claims the pillar blocks your Q. Also left unasserted: whether Satchel Charge's self-knockback escapes the Brittle knockup, and whether Brittle's stun component is reduced by tenacity — neither is in Riot's text.
